name: Camille
content: Camille is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. She has been at St. Joseph’s since sixth grade. She likes to draw, listen to music and play on her cellphone in her spare time. Camille enjoys and participates in a lot of the sports offered to her. Right now, she’s in track and softball. She has done archery, as well. She likes the staff and students at St. Joseph’s, and all the activities she gets to choose from. She says St. Joseph’s has helped her socialize and make close friends. She is thankful for her family, friends and staff! She wants to continue to the high school program, and graduate just like her brother! After high school graduation, she wants to find a fun and decent-paying job. Her hope for the future is to be successful. She wants to make her family proud and be proud of herself in everything she accomplishes.

name: Tristan
content: Hehaka Wambli (Tristan) is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. He has been at St. Joseph’s for seven years. In his free time, he likes to play basketball. He has participated in basketball and softball while at St. Joseph’s. He likes the opportunities he has had at St. Joseph’s. He said going to school here has helped give him a stable environment. He is most thankful for everything St. Joseph’s has provided for him. Hehaka would like to continue to the high school program. He wants to go to college to be a mechanic after high school. His hope for the future is success in everything he does.

name: Zenneth
content: Zenneth is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. He has been at St. Joseph’s since the first grade. He likes to play sports and be active in his spare time. Zenneth has participated in football, cross country, basketball and track while at St. Joseph’s. He likes the activities and opportunities he has had while here. He says St. Joseph’s has helped with his education, and he is thankful for that. He plans on continuing to high school after eighth grade graduation. Zenneth wants to enter the work force after he graduates from high school. His hope for the future is to have a stable life he enjoys.

name: Jay
content: Jay is a member of the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. He has been at St. Joseph’s since first grade. He likes to play basketball or workout in his spare time. Jay has participated in football, basketball and softball while at St. Joseph’s. Going to school at St. Joseph’s has helped him with his education, but also it has taught him to be respectful and kind. He is thankful for his family and sports. He would like to join the high school program, graduate and then play college football. Jay wants to go to college for marine biology after high school. His hope for the future is to be successful.

name: Crystal
content: Crystal is a member of the Yankton Sioux Tribe. She has been at St. Joseph’s since fourth grade. She likes to hang out with friends, play games and talk to her houseparents in her spare time. She has participated in volleyball, basketball, gymnastics, Dancing Dolls, track and softball while at St. Joseph’s. Crystal likes the energy, staff, students and activities she’s been a part of at St. Joseph’s. She is thankful for the staff, her friends and family, especially her mom and siblings. She would like to continue to the high school program and go to college after graduation. She wants to go to cosmetology school after she graduates high school. She is also thinking about phlebotomy! She would like to have a family, and work toward everything she’s hoped and dreamed of.

name: Kyler
content: Kyler is a member of the Yankton Sioux Tribe. He has been at St. Joseph’s for seven years. He likes to play basketball and hang out with friends in his spare time. Kyler has participated in football, basketball and softball while at St. Joseph’s. He likes the friends he’s made, activities he’s participated in, the staff and the things they’ve taught him here. Going to school at St. Joseph’s has helped him learn what’s right and wrong. He is thankful for his teacher, Nancy; she has pushed him to keep going when things get hard. He would like to continue to the high school program and reach his goals. He wants to go to South Dakota State University after high school and play basketball. He would also like to study construction. His hopes for the future are to be an NBA player and help take care of his mom.

name: Aleighya
content: Aleighya is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. She has been at St. Joseph’s since second grade. In her spare time, she likes to go outside and play basketball. She has participated in volleyball, basketball, track and softball. Aleighya likes the opportunities she’s been given at St. Joseph’s, like donor event trips, home trips and shoes for basketball season. Going to school at St. Joseph’s has helped her find her inner self. She is most thankful for the education she’s received. She would like to continue to the high school program. After high school, she would like to go to law school, or San Diego State University. Her dream job is to be a lawyer or a probation officer. Her hope for the future is to be thoughtful, drug free and have a good education.

name: Jamisha
content: Jamisha is a member of the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. She has been at St. Joseph’s since second grade. In her spare time, she likes to go on walks and play basketball. She has participated in volleyball, basketball and track. Jamisha has liked learning responsibility and getting to experience different things while at St. Joseph’s. Going to school at St. Joseph’s has helped her see the world differently and in a positive manner. She is thankful for everyone who has helped her over the years. She would like to continue to the high school program. After graduating high school, she would like to go to a good college. Her hope for the future is to have a good job, be successful and become a better person each and every day.

name: Margaret
content: Margaret is a member of the Omaha Nations Tribe. This is her first year at St. Joseph’s. In her spare time, Margaret likes to play basketball, spend time with her friends and siblings, sew and listen to music. She has participated in volleyball, basketball, archery, track and softball. She has also danced at St. Joseph’s Annual Powwow and competed in the Royalty Competition. She likes St. Joseph’s because it reminds her of Native American values. She feels respect between students and teachers. She also likes the opportunities, welcoming community and supportive teachers at St. Joseph’s. It has felt more than just a school. Going to school at St. Joseph’s has helped her by giving her the tools and knowledge to achieve her goals. It has taught her not only academics, but also helped her stay connected to her culture, which is important to her. Margaret is most thankful for the supportive teachers and staff who care about her. The school has given her a safe place to grow, learn and dream big. She would like to continue to the high school program. After high school, she would like to go into the military and college. Her dream job is to be an entrepreneur. Her hope for the future is for growth in her culture, and to make her family proud.

name: Carlito
content: Carlito is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. He has been at St. Joseph’s since second grade. In his spare time, he likes to play basketball and hang out with his friends. Carlito has participated in football, basketball, track, archery and softball. He has enjoyed having friends to hang out with and teachers who help him learn. He is most thankful for coming to school here because he has learned things like bravery, courage, generosity and mastery. He would like to continue to the high school program. After high school, he wants to go to college and play football or basketball. His dream job is to be a coach in the NFL. His hope for the future is for Earth to be a better place with peace. He aspires to be successful and make everyone he cares about proud.

name: Eduardo
content: Eduardo is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. He has been at St. Joseph’s since second grade. In Eduardo’s spare time he likes to play basketball or sleep. He has participated in cross country, track and archery while at St. Joseph’s. He likes that he is getting a good education, and the teachers have been helpful. Going to school at St. Joseph’s has helped him be a better person. He is most thankful for his friends and teachers. He would like to continue in the high school program. After high school, he wants to go to college or enter the workforce. His dream job is to be part of a landscaping business. His hope for the future is for good things to happen, and to have helpful thoughts.

name: Jordanna
content: Jordanna is a member of the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. She has been at St. Joseph’s since fifth grade. In her spare time, she likes to go outside with her friends. Jordanna has participated in cross country, basketball and the Spelling Bee while at St. Joseph’s. She likes that her classes work at every student’s individual pace, and staff are patient. Going to school at St. Joseph’s has given her more opportunities to learn things she’s interested in. She would like to continue to the high school program. After high school, she would like to go to college. Her dream job is undecided, but she’s leaning toward a veterinarian or lawyer. Her hope for the future is to be successful in whatever career she chooses.

name: Romeo
content: Romeo is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. He has been at St. Joseph’s since first grade. In Romeo’s spare time he likes to play basketball, lift weights and hang out with his friends. He participated in powwow, football, basketball, softball and wrestling. He likes the help and opportunities St. Joseph’s has given him. Going to school at St. Joseph’s has helped him mature. He is most thankful for the staff. He would like to continue to the high school program. After high school, he would like to go to college and play sports. Romeo’s hopes for the future are to be successful in whatever he chooses to do, and to still be in touch with his friends.

name: Melissa
content: Melissa is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. She has been at St. Joseph’s since first grade. In her spare time, she likes to hang out with her friends. She has participated in Acalympics, Beta Club, archery, Dancing Dolls and gymnastics while at St. Joseph’s. She likes the school, friends and staff. Going to school at St. Joseph’s has given her more opportunities to travel and gain knowledge she might not have gotten at a different school. She is most thankful for her friends and family. She would like to continue to the high school program. She would like to go to college after high school, but doesn’t have a career in mind yet. Her hopes for the future are for her friends and family to have a good life.

name: Persais
content: Persais is a member of the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. She has been at St. Joseph’s since fourth grade. In her spare time, she loves to read and hang out with her friends. She has participated in basketball and track while at St. Joseph’s. She has liked the new elective classes that have been added to her schedule this year. Going to school at St. Joseph’s has helped her by teaching her new things and social skills. She is thankful for all the staff and her Family Service Counselor. She would like to continue to the high school program. After high school, she would like to go to college for a career in the medical field. She would also like to join the National Guard. Her dream job is to be a nurse, so she can help people. Her hope for the future is to be successful.

name: Victoria
content: Victoria is a member of the Yankton Sioux Tribe. She has been at St. Joseph’s since sixth grade. In Victoria’s spare time she likes to hang out with her friends. She has participated in volleyball and has enjoyed all the opportunities St. Joseph’s has provided her. Going to school at St. Joseph’s has helped her figure out what she wants for her future. She is thankful for St. Joseph’s, her teachers, houseparents and friends. She would like to continue to the high school program. After high school, she would like to go to college; although, she doesn’t have a career in mind yet. Her hopes for the future are to work for the future she wants.

name: Brooklynn
content: Brooklynn is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. Her favorite memories at St. Joseph’s include staying in the break home with her sister and going on home trips. Brooklynn’s favorite trip was going to Thunder Road because her houseparents let her drive the go-karts! Her favorite activity she’s done at school is “I Hate Winter Day” because she loves snow cones and competing in the coloring contest. Something Brooklynn has learned at St. Joseph’s is how to clean and how to manage her money. After 8th grade graduation, Brooklynn plans to stay and attend the St. Joseph’s high school program. She also wants to get a job to earn money for family members if needed. Brooklynn’s dreams for the future are to be a voice actor and have other side jobs. She’d also like to have a house or apartment!

name: Janessa
content: Janessa’s favorite school memory is spending time with her best friend, Mykah. Her favorite memory from her campus home is staying up late in 7th grade to tell scary stories in the basement. Janessa’s favorite trip while at St. Joseph’s was the 7th Grade Cultural Trip. Her favorite activity is playing volleyball. While at St. Joseph’s, Janessa has learned to get along with others and social skills. She plans to join the St. Joseph’s high school program after 8th grade graduation. Janessa’s dream for the future is to go to cosmetology school!

name: James
content: James is a member of the Yankton Sioux Tribe. James’ favorite school memory was the 7th Grade Cultural Trip because he learned more about his culture. His favorite memory from his campus home is playing basketball with Malikai. James’s favorite trip while at St. Joseph’s was the Donor Event in Dallas, Texas. He spoke in front of the donors and answered their questions. He also got to experience virtual reality for the first time! His favorite activities at St. Joseph’s are basketball and football. James has learned how to control his anger and how that can keep him out of trouble while at St. Joseph’s. He plans on continuing with St. Joseph’s high school program after 8th grade graduation. James’ dreams for the future are to go to college and play basketball or maybe join the military!

name: Tyree
content: Tyree is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. Tyree’s favorite school memory was meeting his mentor, Ben. His favorite memory in his campus home has been game night in Perky Home. Tyree’s favorite trip at St. Joseph’s was a school trip with his campus home. His favorite activity with St. Joseph’s is softball. Tyree has learned how to cook while being at St. Joseph’s. After 8th graduation, he plans to set the highest bench press record. Tyree would like to succeed and strive for better.

name: Mykah
content: Mykah is a member of the Northern Arapaho Tribe. Mykah’s favorite school memory is meeting and spending time with her best friend, Janessa. Her favorite memory from her campus home is going on a trip to a hotel. She and Rylee both fell off the slide; she thought it was funny. Mykah’s favorite trip at St. Joseph’s was the 7th Grade Cultural Trip. Her favorite activity she’s participated in at St. Joseph’s is playing basketball. Something Mykah has learned at St. Joseph’s is to focus on things and never give up. After 8th grade graduation, she plans to continue with the St. Joseph’s high school program. Mykah’s dream for the future is to work as a mechanic.

name: Rayne
content: Rayne is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. Rayne’s favorite school memory is attending the Donor Event in Sacramento, CA, with Jesse and Pte San. She has enjoyed all the homes she’s been in. Rayne’s favorite trip at St. Joseph’s was to a museum in with Claire, the librarian, and her classmates. Her favorite activity at St. Joseph’s was the pajama days and volleyball with coaches Jennie, Kim and Jesse. Since being at St. Joseph’s, Rayne has learned manners, cleaning up after herself and taking on responsibility. After 8th grade graduation, she plans to join St. Joseph’s high school program. Rayne’s dreams for the future are still undecided!

name: Kellen
content: Kellen is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. Kellen’s favorite school memory is when the teacher dressed up as students. His favorite memory from his campus home is when they would go to Sioux Falls on a home trip. Kellen’s favorite trip since he’s been at St. Joseph’s is when the 7th-12th grade went to Sioux Falls for a Skyforce game. His favorite activities at St. Joseph’s have been basketball, cross country and boat races in Dan’s science class. Since being at St. Joseph’s, Kellen has learned how to speak the Lakota language. After 8th grade graduation, he plans to finish high school. Kellen’s dream for the future is to play college basketball.

name: Randi
content: Randi is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. Randi’s favorite school memory is doing the boat races in Dan’s science class. Her favorite memory from her campus home is when they went to Rapid City and went to a water park on a home trip. Randi’s favorite trip was when the 7th-12th grades went to the Skyforce game in Sioux Falls. Her favorite activity at St. Joseph’s has been basketball. Something Randi has learned at St. Joseph’s is, “Don’t do drugs; they are bad.” After 8th grade graduation, she plans to join St. Joseph’s high school program and graduate. Randi’s dream for the future is to be a movie producer!

name: Blayze
content: Blayze is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. Blayze’s favorite school memory is the Staff vs. Students games. His favorite memories from his campus home were going to Rapid City and hiking with the Perky Home in 6th grade. Blayze’s favorite trip while at St. Joseph’s was the 7th Grade Cultural Trip. He also enjoyed going to the State Fair. His favorite activity at St. Joseph’s has been playing basketball outside with everyone and his coaches, Evan and Colton. Something Blayze has learned while at St. Joseph’s is you can’t always win, sometimes you have to lose. After 8th grade graduation, he plans on continuing with high school. He would also like to continue to play football and basketball. Blayze’s dreams for the future are to get a D1 scholarship for basketball or join the military!

name: Tristine
content: Tristine is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. Tristine’s favorite school memory is going on the 7th Grade Cultural Trip. Her favorite memories in the homes were being in her 6th grade home and April Fool’s Day. Tristine’s favorite trip while at St. Joseph’s was going to Washington, D.C., in 7th grade. Her favorite activity at St. Joseph’s has been playing volleyball. Tristine has enjoyed all the knowledge she gained while at St. Joseph’s. After 8th grade graduation, she plans on continuing to high school. Tristine’s dream for the future is to be a journalist!

name: Victor
content: Victor is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. Victor’s favorite school memory is building the boats and then racing them in the pool in Dan’s science class. His favorite memories in his campus home were going on trips and having water balloon fights. Victor’s favorite trip at St. Joseph’s was going to Houston, Texas, at the end of 6th grade. He also enjoyed the 7th Grade Cultural Trip for the hikes. His favorite activities were track, cross country, football and softball. Something Victor has learned while being at St. Joseph’s was how to take care of himself. After 8th grade graduation, he plans on joining St. Joseph’s high school program. Victor’s dream for the future is to go to college.

name: John
content: John is a member of the Oglala Sioux Tribe. John’s favorite school memory was being in Nancy’s 7th grade class because she taught them a lot about their culture. He also enjoyed the fashion show and taking pictures during that event. His favorite memory from the campus home was going to the State Fair in Huron. John’s favorite trip he’s taken while at St. Joseph’s was the 7th Grade Cultural Trip. He liked learning more about his culture and the hikes. His favorite activity at St. Joseph’s was playing sports like basketball and football. He also enjoyed playing hide-and-seek with his houseparents. Some things John has learned while at St. Joseph’s are more about his culture, how to speak more clearly and how to dance in the Powwow. After 8th grade graduation, he plans to work in the summer and join St. Joseph’s high school program. John’s dream for the future is to make a lot of money!

name: Darnel
content: Darnel is a member of the Yankton Sioux Tribe. Darnel’s favorite school memory was going to the Badlands in 6th grade. His favorite memory from his campus home was his 6th grade trip with Fisher Home. Darnel’s favorite trip while at St. Joseph’s was the 7th Grade Cultural Trip. His favorite activities were basketball, football and track. While at St. Joseph’s, Darnel has learned how to take care of a home. After 8th grade graduation, he plans on continuing to high school. Darnel’s dream for the future is to go to the military!

name: Tatiyopa
content: Tatiyopa is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. Tatiyopa’s favorite school memory was when Nancy, her teacher, randomly danced in class. Her favorite memory from her campus home was watching a meteor shower with her houseparents. Tatiyopa’s favorite trip while at St. Joseph’s was going to the Skyforce game with the 7th-12th graders. Her favorite activities were volleyball and the inflatables. Some things Tatiyopa has learned while at St. Joseph’s are taking responsibility and thinking before you act. After 8th grade graduation, she plans to join St. Joseph’s high school program and possibly join volleyball. Tatiyopa’s dreams for the future are to become a paramedic, a traveling nurse or join the military!

name: Sophia
content: Pte San Sophia’s favorite school memory was when she went on the 7th Grade Cultural Trip. Her favorite memory in her campus home was wrapping presents with one of her houseparents. They wrapped them so they were hard to open! Pte San’s favorite trip while at St. Joseph’s was going to Rapid City and down the “Toilet Bowl” at Watiki Waterpark. Her favorite activities are volleyball, basketball, track and softball. At St. Joseph's, Pte San has learned how to make friends and improve her basketball skills. After graduation, she plans to join St. Joseph’s high school program. Pte San’s dreams for the future are to be a welder and open a bakery! She also wants to continue playing basketball and live in Sacramento, California!

name: Brayden
content: Brayden is a member of the Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe. Brayden’s favorite school memory was the Staff vs. 8th Grade games. His favorite memory from his campus home was going on a haunted trail. Brayden’s favorite trip while at St. Joseph’s was the 7th Grade Cultural Trip. He also enjoyed going to the State Fair in Huron. His favorite activity was playing basketball and learning how to play football. Something Brayden has learned while at St. Joseph’s is how to be mature and to set an example. After 8th grade graduation, he plans to continue to learn and develop. He also plans to train in the sport he loves. Brayden’s dreams for the future are to play basketball at a D1 level or make the league.

name: Alexis
content: Alexis is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. Alexis’s favorite school memory was playing hide-and-seek with the 7th-8th grade community at the park. Her favorite memory in the campus home was telling scary stories in the basement with her friends. Alexis’s favorite trip while at St. Joseph’s was was going to Sioux Falls for a Skyforce basketball game. Her favorite activity was playing basketball in 7th grade. Something Alexis has learned while at St. Joseph’s is how to talk to new people. She is undecided about where to attend high school. Alexis’s dream is to become a professional beaded earring maker!

name: Marybella
content: Marybella is a member of the Yankton Sioux Tribe. Marybella’s future hopes and dreams are to make money so she can help her family. She wants to be an astronaut when she grows up. She has loved the trips she’s been able to go on while at St. Joseph’s. She said the girls are the best thing about her home because they are friendly and nice. Marybella’s favorite class is English Language Arts because Nancy mixes in culture with the lessons. She is most proud of the great understanding of her culture that she has gained at St. Joseph’s. She will always remember her friends.

name: Rylee
content: Rylee is a member of the Oglala Sioux Tribe. Rylee’s future hopes and dreams are to be successful in life. She is still deciding what she would like to be when she grows up. Something Rylee has loved about being at St. Joseph’s is the community of staff and students. She said the best part of her home was the girls and the sense of belonging. Her favorite class is English Language Arts. The thing she is most proud of accomplishing at St. Joseph’s is overcoming her fear of public speaking. She will always remember her houseparents.

name: Charges
content: Watahkpe Hoksila (Charges) is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. His future hopes and dreams are to be a tattoo artist or a doctor. Charges is still undecided on what he’d like to be when he grows up. Something he loved about St. Joe’s is the seventh grade Cultural Trip. He thought it was fun and they got to see a lot of cultural sites. He says the best thing about his home are his houseparents because they’re funny. Charges’ favorite class is Personal Living Skills because they get to cook and eat. The thing he is most proud of accomplishing at St. Joseph’s is graduating eighth grade. He will always remember the eighth grade vs. staff basketball game, and it ended in a tie!

name: Kayley
content: Kayley is a member of the Yankton Sioux Tribe. Kayley’s future hopes and dreams are to get into acting, because she would like to be an actress when she grows up. Something she has loved about being at St. Joseph’s was the seventh grade Cultural Trip. They went swimming at Evans Plunge and hiking at Black Elk Peak. The trips were the best part about her home. Kayley’s favorite class is English Language Arts, as Nancy explains the content, and they get to talk to each other. The thing she is most proud of accomplishing at St. Joseph’s is learning to speak-up for herself. She will always remember breaking her ankle while playing tag in sixth grade.

name: Jevjuan
content: Jevjuan is a member of the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. Jevjuan’s future hopes and dreams are to play basketball in the NBA. He wants to be a pro basketball player when he grows up. Something he has loved about being at St. Joseph’s are the trips he’s been able to go on, including the Cultural Trip and the donor luncheon in Florida. He said the best part about his home are his housemates. Jevjuan’s favorite class is math. The thing he is most proud of accomplishing at St. Joseph’s is placing 3rd in the State Free Throw Competition. He will always remember: “Without God, what are you?”

name: Aja
content: Aja is a member of the Yankton Sioux Tribe. Aja’s future hopes and dreams are to graduate high school. She wants to work for NASA in the aeronautical field when she grows up. Something she has loved about being at St. Joseph’s are her friends because they are fun. She said the best thing about her home are the people: they are welcoming and she feels like they all belong together. Aja’s favorite class is English Language Arts and reading. She is most proud of getting good grades while at St. Joseph’s. She will always remember her friends, Nancy, her houseparents, and going to Watiki with the David Home.

name: Taliyah
content: Taliyah is a member of the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. Taliyah’s future hopes and dreams are to go to college and join the military. She wants to be a nurse when she grows up. Some things she has loved about being at St. Joseph’s was Read Across America Week and all the fun she had. She says the best thing about her home are the girls, as they have been very nice. Taliyah’s favorite class is English Language Arts because Jesse is a fun teacher. The thing she is most proud of accomplishing at St. Joseph’s is improving her math skills, since she struggled with that subject before. She will always remember all the friends she made.

name: Tywin
content: Tywin is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. Tywin’s future hopes and dreams are to go to college to become an entomologist, which is a person who studies bugs. Something he has loved about being at St. Joseph’s is meeting his friends and the trips to Rapid City, Wind Cave and Mt. Rushmore. He said the best thing about his home is his friends. Tywin’s favorite class is math. The thing he is most proud of accomplishing at St. Joseph’s is being filmed in St. Joseph’s TV commercial. He will always remember his friends and teachers who helped him along the way.

name: Joanna
content: Joanna is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. She wants to be a traveling nurse or a therapist when she grows up. Something she loved about St. Joe’s is spending time with her friends. She said the best thing about her home is her houseparents. Joanna’s favorite class is English Language Arts. The thing she is most proud of accomplishing at St. Joseph’s is graduating eighth grade. She will always remember the eighth grade vs. staff basketball game.

name: Roxanna
content: Roxanna is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. Roxanna’s future hopes and dreams are to help people. She wants to be a doctor when she grows up. Something she loved about St. Joseph’s include the home trips, sports and fun activities. She said the best thing about her home is the structure and the houseparents. Roxanna’s favorite class is English Language Arts. The thing she is most proud of accomplishing at St. Joseph’s is going out for basketball for the first time and getting an award! She will always remember the opportunities she’s received at St. Joseph’s.

name: Tyson
content: Tyson is still deciding on his future hopes and dreams. He wants to be a farmer when he grows up. Something he loved about being at St. Joseph’s is the help he was able to get with his schoolwork. He said the best thing about his home is his friends. Tyson’s favorite class is math, because he understands it. The thing he is most proud of accomplishing at St. Joseph’s is graduating eighth grade. He will always remember his houseparents over the years.

name: Christine
content: Christine is a member of the Yankton Sioux Tribe. Christine’s future hopes and dreams are to become rich and have a strong, healthy life. She wants to be a traveling nurse when she grows up. Something she loved about St. Joseph’s is having someone to talk to when things aren’t going well. She said the best thing about her home is her houseparents. Christine’s favorite class is Native American Studies. The thing she is most proud of accomplishing at St. Joseph’s is graduating eighth grade. She will always remember the fun rides she had in the Mathias Home.

name: Jubal
content: Jubal is a member of the Oglala Sioux Tribe. Jubal’s future hopes and dreams are to help people. He would like to be a dentist when he grows up. The trips to the State Fair and Mitchell stand out as Jubal’s favorite things at St. Joseph’s. The best part about his home are his houseparents. Jubal’s favorite class is science, specifically the labs because they’re fun. The thing he is most proud of accomplishing at St. Joseph’s is keeping his room clean. He will always remember football.

name: Traevin
content: Traevin is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. Traevin’s future hopes and dreams are to be an NBA Player. He would like to be a middle school basketball coach when he grows up. Something he loved about being at St. Joseph’s is the trips, especially those with Odis and the donor luncheon trip to Florida. Traevin’s favorite class is math, as it is easy for him. The thing he is most proud of accomplishing at St. Joseph’s is keeping his work caught-up, getting good grades and being on Phase 4. He will always remember his houseparents and teachers.

name: Shelleigh
content: Shelleigh is a member of the Three Affiliated Tribes. Shelleigh’s future hopes and dreams are to become a singer and dancer. Something she loved about St. Joseph’s is all the sports and activities she’s been a part of like cross country, volleyball, basketball, track and softball. She said the best thing about her home is having her own room. Shelleigh’s favorite class is art, because she likes to paint. The thing she is most proud of accomplishing at St. Joseph’s is improving and keeping her grades up. She will always remember the inflatables party at the Rec Center.

name: Sequoia
content: Sequoia is a member of the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. Her future hopes and dreams are to keep playing basketball. Sequoia is still deciding what she wants to be when she grows up. Something she has loved about being at St. Joseph’s are the home trips and activities they participate in. Sequoia said meeting new girls is the best part of being in the homes at St. Joseph’s. Sequoia’s favorite class is math because it’s her best grade. The thing she is most proud of accomplishing here is learning to play volleyball. She will always remember how much fun she’s had at St. Joseph’s.

name: Jonaya
content: Jonaya is a member of the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. Jonaya’s future hopes and dreams are to help people. She wants to be a doctor or nurse when she grows up. Something she has loved about being as St. Joseph’s is her friends. She said the best thing about her home are her friends. Jonaya’s favorite class is math. The thing she is most proud of accomplishing at St. Joe’s is being on Phase 4. She will always remember her friends.

name: Mario
content: Mario is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. Mario’s favorite school memory is when they went to Pierre to tour the Capitol because it was fun being together with his class. His favorite memory from time in his home was when they went shopping at the mall during a trip to Sioux Falls. After 8th grade graduation, Mario plans to come back to St. Joe’s and graduate from high school. When he does this, he will have gone to school from 1st-12th grade and be dubbed a “lifer” as we endearingly call them! When he grows up he wants to be a mechanical engineer!

name: Jalonna
content: Jalonna is a member of the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. Jalonna’s favorite school memory is the Cultural Trip because her class went to cultural places she had learned about. Her favorite memories in her home are all the home trips they took throughout the years. After 8th grade graduation, Jalonna wants to get a summer job and go to high school in Chamberlain. Jalonna wants to be a homicide detective when she grows up!

name: Taylen
content: Taylen is a member of the Yankton Sioux Tribe. Taylen’s favorite memory of school is the Staff vs. Students basketball game. He said it was fun to play against older people! His favorite memory in the home was laughing with the boys and houseparents. After 8th grade graduation, Taylen plans to go to high school and go to college. When he grows up, Taylen would like to be a basketball player or basketball coach!

name: Makaia
content: MaKaia is a member of the Turtle Mountain Band. MaKaia’s favorite school memory is the 7th grade Cultural Trip because they explored and learned new things! Her favorite memories in the home are playing hide and seek and socializing! MaKaia plans to be in the St. Joe’s high school program after 8th grade graduation. She wants to be a physical therapist when she grows up!

name: Memphis
content: Memphis is a member of the Yankton Sioux Tribe. Memphis’ favorite school memory is meeting new friends and meeting with his counselor. His favorite memories are going fishing with his houseparents, the 7th grade Cultural Trip, going to Bear Butte, and participating in sweats (inípi) with Scott, a St. Joe’s counselor. After 8th grade graduation, Memphis plans to go to high school in Chamberlain. He is still exploring his options for what he wants to be when he grows up.

name: Kaedyn
content: Kaedyn is a member of the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. Kaedyn’s favorite school memory is the buffalo harvest because he liked the view of all the buffalo. His favorite memory in his home was hanging out with brothers. Kaedyn plans on going home and finishing high school after 8th grade graduation. When he grows up, Kaedyn wants to be an artist!

name: Amelia
content: Amelia is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. Amelia’s favorite school memories include a fun game of tag and the 7th grade Cultural Trip because she learned about her culture with friends! Her favorite memory in her home was playing hide-and-seek with other homes. Amelia plans to stay at St. Joe’s through high school and graduate. When she grows up, Amelia wants to work with kids!

name: Jack
content: Jack is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. Jack’s favorite school memory is enjoying time outside of the classroom with friends. His favorite home memory is staying up all night with everyone. After 8th grade graduation, Jack plans to attend high school but is still deciding where he wants to attend. When he grows up, Jack wants to go into the military!

name: Paul
content: Paul is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. Paul’s favorite school memory is the 7th grade Cultural Trip. While at Bear Butte, a cloud came to the class while they were singing. His favorite memories in his home were the water balloon fights! Paul plans to go to Chamberlain High School after 8th grade graduation. When he grows up, Paul wants to go into the military!

name: Demarius
content: Demarius is a member of the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. Demarius’ favorite school memory is the Cultural Trip because the cabin was big! He also liked going out of state. His favorite memory in the home is when all the homes played hide and seek. Demarius plans on going to high school and getting a job after 8th grade graduation. When he grows up, he wants to be a pilot!

name: Oyate
content: Oyate is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. Oyate’s favorite school memories are having fun and learning. His favorite memories in the home are the trips to Sioux Falls, especially eating out and going to AirMadness with his friends. After 8th grade graduation, Oyate plans to have a fun summer and then, this fall, be a part of the St. Joe’s high school program to attend Chamberlain High School. When he grows up, he wants to play sports!

name: Emilia
content: Emilia is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. Emilia’s favorite school memories are the cultural trip and being with friends. Her favorite memory in the home is the home trip to Rapid City, SD. After 8th grade graduation, Emilia plans on finishing high school but she is still deciding where she will attend. When Emilia grows up, she wants to be self-employed and make her own ribbon skirts and do her own beadwork!

name: Secret
content: Secret is a member of the Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe. Secret’s favorite school memory is the Cultural Trip because she got to learn more about her culture. Her favorite home memories include when they would have water fights, and also when they would stay up and watch movies outside. After 8th grade graduation, Secret plans to graduate high school. When Secret grows up she plans on saving up money to get an apartment of her own and get a job. Secret wants to be a doctor and have a profession!

name: Gabriel
content: Gabriel is a member of the Yankton Sioux Tribe. Gabe’s favorite school memory is the Students vs. Staff basketball game. His favorite memory in the home is playing basketball with his home. After 8th grade graduation, Gabe wants to attend high school at Chamberlain and work harder in basketball. When he grows up, Gabe wants to play for the NBA!

name: Consuelo
content: Consuelo is a member of the Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe. Consuelo’s favorite memory in school is the buffalo hunt because she saw the process and all the stuff you can get from harvesting a buffalo. Her favorite home memory was playing hide and seek in the homes and going on drives. Consuelo plans to be in the high school program at St. Joe’s and go to Chamberlain High School. When she grows up, she wants to be a social worker!

name: Jules
content: Jules is a member of the Yankton Sioux Tribe. Jules’ favorite school memory was when they hiked Black Elk Peak for the 7th Grade Cultural trip — it was fun! His favorite memory in the home was going on home trips. Jules plans to stay at St. Joseph’s for the high school program after 8th grade graduation. When he grows up, Jules wants to be a basketball player or mechanic!

name: Gabe
content: Gabe is a member of the Oglala Sioux Tribe. His favorite memory of school is the 7th Grade Cultural trip, specifically Bear Butte and Black Elk Peak. His favorite memory in the home was of William (a classmate) falling down the stairs in the Speyer Home. Gabe plans to stay at St. Joseph’s for the high school program after graduating 8th grade. When he grows up, he wants to be a mechanic!

name: Shayla
content: Shayla is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. Shayla’s favorite school memory is when she and Ava were washing dishes in Personal Living Skills and the sink sprayer got stuck, sprayed her when it turned on, and Ava just stood there laughing at her. Her favorite home memory is when Stevens and Mathias Homes were walking back from the river and it was very windy that day and Shayla, Amelia, and Emilia saw the water fountain blowing high in the wind so they asked Miss Evelyn to walk by the museum and they ran toward the fountain. Amelia ran through the fountain and Shayla and Emilia were getting soaking wet from the wind blowing the water on them. After 8th grade graduation, Shayla plans on finishing high school in Chamberlain. She wants to travel around the country when she grows up!

name: Delante
content: Delante is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. Delante’s favorite memory of school is the 7th Grade Cultural trip: he got to spend a week with friends and had the chance to speak with an elder about the “becoming a man” ceremony at Bear Butte. His favorite home memory is going to Watiki in second grade with his home. Delante plans to attend Chamberlain High School after 8th grade graduation. When Delante grows up, he wants to be successful!

name: Waniyetu
content: Waniyetu (Misun) is a member of the Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe. Waniyetu’s favorite school memory was during PE with Pam in 2nd grade: he found a stick and realized a snake was wrapped around it. It was the farthest he has ever jumped! His favorite memory in the home is going on home trips. Waniyetu plans to stay at St. Joseph’s for the high school program after 8th grade graduation. When he grows up, Waniyetu wants to become a Marine or do something with technology.

name: Kansas
content: Kansas is a member of the Yankton Sioux Tribe. Kansas’ favorite memory of school is the staff vs. student game his 8th grade year. His favorite home memories are the home trips. Kansas plans to attend Chamberlain High School after 8th grade graduation. When he grows up, Kansas wants to be successful!

name: Akicita
content: Akicita is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. Akicita’s favorite school memory is the 7th Grade Cultural trip because he got to hang out with friends and walked up Black Elk Peak. His favorite home memories are all of the home trips! Akicita plans to attend high school after 8th grade graduation, either through St. Joseph’s program or at home. When he grows up, Akicita would like to go into the military, possibly the Air Force, and wants to walk in a traditional way.

name: William
content: William is a member of the Yankton Sioux Tribe. William’s favorite school memory is going on the 7th Grade Cultural trip with his friends. His favorite memory in the homes is of his making friends at St. Joseph’s Indian School. William plans to attend either Chamberlain or Mitchell High School after 8th grade graduation. William wants to be successful when he grows up!

name: LaShanti
content: LaShanti is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. LaShanti’s favorite school memory is visiting the high school homes. Her favorite home memory is having a sleepover in the living room and watching movies. After 8th grade graduation, LaShanti plans on spending time with her brothers and going into the St. Joseph’s high school program. LaShanti wants to be a 1st grade teacher or a fashion designer when she grows up.

name: Ezmiah
content: Ezmiah is a member of the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. Ezmiah’s favorite school memory is making castles with cardboard boxes. Her favorite memory in the home is when she went to the zoo in Sioux Falls, SD. Ezmiah’s plans after 8th grade graduation are saving up for college and getting a job. When she grows up, Ezmiah wants to go to college and play college basketball!

name: Latoya
content: Latoya is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. Latoya’s favorite school memory is when they had “I Hate Winter” Day. Her favorite home memory is going to Sioux Falls, SD, in the 6th grade. Latoya plans to stay at St. Joseph’s for the high school program after 8th grade graduation. When she grows up, Latoya wants to be a carpenter.

name: Armand
content: Armand is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. Armand’s favorite school memory was the 7th Grade Cultural trip when they climbed Black Elk Peak. His favorite home memories are the home trips taken and laughing with friends. Armand plans on completing high school and getting a job after 8th grade graduation. When he grows up, he wants to get a job and be successful!

name: Kaylee
content: Kaylee is a member of the Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe. Kaylee’s favorite school memory was the 7th Grade cultural trip, when she was able to see Native American cultural sites in-person. Her favorite memory in the home is having a glow stick party with some friends — it was very fun! Kaylee plans to stay at St. Joseph’s for the high school program after 8th grade graduation. When she grows up, Kaylee wants to be a horse trainer, designer, and counselor!

name: Jose
content: Jose is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. Jose’s favorite memory in school is the 7th grade Cultural Trip: the group was eating pizza during a tornado watch. His favorite home memory is being in Speyer Home in 7th grade with Mr. Brian. Jose is undecided in his plans after 8th grade graduation. When he grows up, Jose plans on being successful!

name: Neleigh
content: Neleigh is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. Neleigh’s favorite school memory is when she threw woodchips at her classmate, Na’Taye. Her favorite memory in the home was when Tara (her houseparent) went to scare Loren as a joke. Neleigh plans on going to high school after 8th grade graduation. When she grows up, Neleigh wants to be a cosmetologist or a detective like Lieutenant Benson from Law and Order!

name: Angelina
content: Angelina is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe, the Sicangu Lakota. Angelina’s favorite memory of school was when her class went outside for PE and the slides were wet, so they all slid down them and ended up with soaking pants. Her favorite home memory was when she and LC ran around outside laughing really hard until they couldn’t run anymore. Angelina plans on coming back to St. Joseph’s for her freshman year and joining the basketball and volleyball teams at Chamberlain High School. She wants to be an artist when she grows up!

name: Landon
content: Landon is a member of the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa. Landon’s favorite memory of school was the cultural trip. His favorite home memories include the Halloween celebrations! Landon plans to stay at St. Joseph’s for the high school program after 8th grade graduation. He wants to attend college and begin a career when he grows up!

name: Lars
content: Lars is a member of the Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe. Lars’ favorite school memory is the cultural trip. His favorite memory in the home is the home trip with houseparents Odis and Brett. They stayed in cabins and Odis told scary stories. Lars plans to attend the St. Joseph’s high school program after 8th grade graduation. He wants to possibly be a welder when he grows up!

name: Kenyon
content: Kenyon is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. Kenyon’s favorite memory of school is the cultural trip — especially hiking Bear Butte. His favorite home memory is hanging out with friends in his home. Kenyon plans to attend the St. Joseph’s high school program after 8th grade graduation. He would like to play professional basketball when he grows up!

name: DeVarrell
content: DeVarrell is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. DeVarrell’s favorite class was Math. His favorite memories in the home are going on home trips with his houseparents Odis and Theresa and when he and his friends rode around on their bikes! When he grows up, DeVarrell would like to be a welder.

name: Aiden
content: Aiden is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. Aiden’s favorite school memory is of the cultural trip and having the best laughs with his friends. His favorite memory in the home is having fun at an indoor water park on a home trip. Aiden plans on returning to St. Joseph’s for the high school program after graduating 8th grade. He wants to be a professional basketball player when he grows up!

name: Jacob
content: Jacob is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. Jacob’s favorite memory of school was the cultural trip. His favorite home memory was when his home travelled to Niobrara for a home trip. Jacob plans to go to high school in Chamberlain or a nearby town after 8th grade graduation. He wants to join the NBA when he grows up!

name: William
content: William is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. William’s favorite school memory is a time at lunch when Aiden, his classmate, got milk on himself. William plans on going to high school and college after graduating 8th grade. When he grows up, he wants to be a rancher or a “teeth fixer”!

name: Richard
content: Richard is a member of the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. Richard’s favorite memory of school was being the volleyball team manager! His favorite home memory is going tubing in the snow at Great Bear in Sioux Falls, SD. Richard plans on attending Chamberlain High School after 8th grade graduation. He is still exploring his options for future careers!

name: Loren
content: Loren is a member of the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. Loren’s favorite school memory was the cultural trip because the basement of the cabin where the boys stayed was fun. His favorite memory in the home was hanging out with his housemates over the past two years. Loren plans to attend the St. Joseph’s high school program after 8th grade graduation. He would like to be an electrician or serve in the military when he grows up!

name: Brianna
content: Brianna is a member of the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. Brianna’s favorite memory of school was in 7th grade just before Spring Break. Mr. Baldwin was on his computer (taking online CPR) and Jacob asked him what he was doing. He said, “Tryna save your life, THAT’S WHAT I’M DOIN’! Come here.” Jake and Aiden went up to Dave, but when he told them to lay down to demonstrate CPR they made funny faces and ran away. Her favorite home memory was the snowball fight with another home, and the snow was so wet his jacket and clothes were soaked. Brianna plans to attend high school after 8th grade graduation. She wants to be a zoologist to help monkeys, elephants, and tigers, or she wants to be a supervisory special agent for the FBI when she grows up!

name: Leslie
content: Leslie is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. Leslie will always remember Sarah (her teacher) having to match every day in school as her favorite school memory. Her favorite memories in the home were when her home went to the State Fair and to the movies. Leslie plans to attend the St. Joseph’s high school program after 8th grade graduation. She is still exploring ideas for her future plans after high school!

name: Mersayis
content: Mersayis is a member of the Yankton Sioux Tribe. Mersayis’ favorite school memory is being in Bobbi’s classroom and laughing and making memories. Another favorite was when they went on the cultural trip. They hiked Black Elk Peak. Mersayis’ favorite home memory was when they went on their home trip to Rapid City. It was her favorite because she was surrounded by the people she felt closest to. Mersayis would like to attend Chamberlain High School (as part of the St. Joseph’s high school program), get good grades and graduate. She would like to be a pediatric nurse or neonatal nurse when she grows up!

Back Row: Elron, Jordan, Fr. Anthony, Isaiah, Vincent, Everardo Row 3: Kaiden, Amiel, Jackson, Jolissa, Melissa, Taylor Row 2: Addisson, Jeremy, Eden, Julian, Eric, Juliana, Clarysia Front Row: Zaley, Zeke, Landon, Sunni, Javin

name: Joselle
content: Joselle is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. Joselle has attended St. Joseph’s Indian School for one year. She has loved all the staff while here at St. Joseph’s — how nice they are and how they want students to succeed. Joselle’s favorite class is Personal Living Skills. The best thing about her home was her friends and houseparents. Joselle is most grateful for the staff and is very proud of her good grades. After finishing school, she dreams of being a photographer.

name: Bradyn
content: Bradyn is a member of the Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe. Bradyn has participated in basketball, cross country and track while attending St. Joseph’s. He loves being in sports and hanging out with friends. His favorite class is Math and his favorite home activities were the home trips! Bradyn is most grateful for his mom enrolling him at St. Joseph’s to receive a better education and make new friends. He is most proud of making his mom happy by participating in sports and getting good grades. Bradyn will always remember the home and Cultural Trips he went on, but especially the Air Madness trip with Speyer Home, the Seventh Grade Cultural trip, and going to Sioux Falls his eighth grade year. Bradyn hopes to get a college degree and dreams of becoming an artist.

name: Julius
content: Julius is a member of the Yankton Sioux Tribe. During his two years at St. Joseph’s, he has participated in football, basketball and softball. He has appreciated the trips he’s taken, and also that he has been well taken care of. His favorite class is PE because of the activities. The best thing about his home was the food and the houseparents. Julius is very grateful for the trips he’s gone on and is proud of being responsible and respectful. Julius will always remember his Cultural Trip to Black Elk Peak when Delmar and Juju had to go to the bathroom and they were racing and Delmar got there first, and Juju had to go really bad, so he used the girls’ room. Julius dreams of going to college and possibly becoming a firefighter.

name: Jada
content: Jada is a member of the Oglala Sioux Tribe. She has attended St. Joseph’s for five years and was involved in basketball, volleyball, softball, Beta Club, Honor Roll and Outstanding Attendance. Something Jada has loved about being here at St. Joseph’s is that it took her into new and exciting things! Out of all the classes, Jada’s favorites are Religion and History because both are fun and cool to learn about. The best thing about Jada’s home is everyone makes her happy and feel supported. She is most grateful for all her friends. Jada is proud of her eighth grade year, because sometimes she didn’t know if she could make it, but she did! She will always remember the Seventh Grade Cultural trip because it was a good time with all her friends and she experienced a lot about her culture. Jada dreams of being a model for a fashion designer someday, or perhaps a doctor!

name: Jade
content: Jade is a member of the Oglala Sioux Tribe. She has participated in basketball, volleyball and track during her five years at St. Joseph’s. Jade has loved the houseparents, counselors, home trips and the education she received at St. Joseph’s. Her favorite class was math because it comes easy for her. The best thing about her home is Rich and Tara’s food and Ms. Julie and Mr. Rigo’s children. She is very grateful for her houseparents, and is proud to be graduating eighth grade this year. She will always remember the memorable moments on the Washington trip! Her future hopes are to go to college and get a good job. She wants to be a flight attendant someday!

name: Nevaeh
content: Nevaeh is a member of the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. During her time at St. Joseph’s she has been involved in basketball, volleyball, track, softball, National Honor Society, and Junior Beta Club. She has loved the Rec Center and the people she has met — the staff and the donors — while at St. Joseph’s. Her favorite class was Religion and the best thing about her home was Tara’s cooking. She is very grateful for the donors, friends and family. Nevaeh is proud to be graduating eighth grade with her friends. She will always remember when the Mathias Home had a water balloon fight with the rest of the 7th/8th community. Nevaeh dreams of graduating high school, and attending a four-year college for event management. She wants to be an event planner when she grows up.

name: Julian
content: Julian is enrolled in the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. He has been in basketball, track and football while here at St. Joseph’s. Julian has loved playing sports during his time at St. Joseph’s and his favorite class is Nancy’s math class. The best things about his home are the home trips and hanging out with his friends. Julian is grateful for his education here at St. Joseph’s and is proud of graduating the eighth grade. He will always remember all the places he went to on the Seventh Grade Cultural trip. His future hopes and dreams include graduating high school, going into the Army, and then traveling the world!

name: Basil
content: Basil is a member of the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. Basil has been attending St. Joseph’s since first grade for a total of eight years! While he’s been here, he has participated in basketball, track, cross country and softball. He has loved the chances St. Joseph’s gives — especially the donor luncheons. Basil’s favorite class was PE and the best thing about his home is it helped him learn right from wrong. He is most grateful for the education and chances that not every child gets. Basil is very proud of learning how to grow up without drugs or alcohol. He will always remember the Seventh Grade Cultural trip and his trip to Orlando, Florida Basil dreams of getting a job and helping his family.

name: Taivin
content: Taivin is a member of the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. During his four years at St. Joseph’s, he has been involved in football, basketball, Explorers, track and softball. He has loved going to baseball trips with the Explorers Club while at St. Joseph’s. Math is Taivin’s favorite class. The best thing about his St. Joseph’s home is the houseparents! Taivin is most grateful for the good education St. Joseph’s provides. He is extremely proud of his grades. Taivin’s future hopes and dreams are to graduate high school, go to college and become a firefighter.

name: Destiny
content: Destiny is a member of the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. While at St. Joseph’s, she has participated in basketball, volleyball, cheerleading, softball and the YES Girls program. Destiny has loved that there is always something to do at St. Joseph’s. Her favorite class is art. The best thing about her home is hanging out with friends and having a good time. Destiny is most grateful for her friends and family. She is proud of her accomplishments to make her family proud and graduate. Destiny will always remember laughing with her friends. Destiny’s future hopes and dreams are to go into the National Guard and college. She wants to be a photographer someday.

name: Lavella
content: Lavella is a member of the Oglala Sioux Tribe. She has been here at St. Joseph’s for two years. During that time, she was involved in volleyball, track, basketball and softball. She has loved the home trips while here at St. Joseph’s. Lavella’s favorite class is Math, and the best thing about her home are her friends. She is most grateful for friends and family. Lavella is proud that she joined track. She will always remember her time with friends. Lavella’s future hopes and dreams are to go to college and become a dentist one day.

name: Walter
content: Walter is enrolled in the Oglala Sioux Tribe. During his two years at St. Joseph’s, he has participated in basketball, track, football, softball, cross country and wrestling. He has loved going to school here at St. Joseph’s and learning new things. Walter’s favorite class is Math because he is always learning new things. The best thing about his home are the home trips. Walter is most grateful for being at St. Joseph’s and is very proud of his learning, his math skills, and just being a part of St. Joseph’s! He will always remember his home trips and the Seventh Grade Cultural trip. He dreams of going to college and one day being an electrician!

name: Ivis
content: Ivis is enrolled in the Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe. He has been in football and basketball during his time at St. Joseph’s. Ivis loves having lots of friends at St. Joseph’s. His favorite class is Math, and the best thing about his home is that it had a lot of video games. Ivis is grateful for basketball and is proud to have accomplished graduating from the eighth grade. He will always remember the Seventh Grade Cultural trip when they got to go to Evan’s Plunge. Ivis’ future hopes and dreams are to be in the military — more specifically, the Marines.

name: Diamond
content: Diamond is a Rosebud Sioux Tribal member. She has attended St. Joseph’s for eight years and has participated in basketball, cheerleading, volleyball, softball, Beta Club and National Honor’s Society. St. Joseph’s has given her the opportunities to travel, meet new people and receive a great education. Her favorite class is Native American Studies and the best thing about her home was the houseparents. Diamond is most grateful for the staff who helped her and is very proud to be finishing the eighth grade here at St. Joseph’s. She will always remember traveling to different states while at St. Joseph’s. Diamond’s future hope is to graduate college, travel and one day become a lawyer

name: Larsten
content: Larsten is a member of the Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe. During her year here at St. Joseph’s, she was involved in cheerleading. She has loved St. Joseph’s and her favorite classes are Religion and English-Language Arts. The best thing about her home is the food! Larsten is most grateful for her teachers and houseparents and is proud of her attendance this year. She will always remember the great effort her homeroom teacher always gave her! Larsten’s dream is to become a successful writer one day.

name: Razalia
content: Razalia is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. She has been in volleyball, basketball, cheerleading, and track while here at St. Joseph’s. She has loved all the opportunities St. Joseph’s has given her. Razalia’s favorite class was art. The best things about her home were the memories she made with the other girls she lived with and her houseparents. She is most grateful for the experiences she’s had with her friends and family. She is most proud of being able to go to Washington D.C. She will always remember the memories she made with new friends! Razalia’s future hope is to be able to do one of her dream jobs: cosmetologist or accountant.

name: Sheresa
content: Sheresa is enrolled in the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. She has been at St. Joseph’s since the fifth grade. She took part in volleyball and the graduation committee during that time. She loved that St. Joseph’s staff encouraged her to do better. Sheresa’s favorite class is Algebra and the best thing about her home was the houseparents! Sheresa is most grateful for her mom, grandma and family. She is proud of her accomplishments and graduating from the eighth grade. Sheresa will always remember her seventh grade home trip with Chuck and Rachel. Sheresa’s future hopes and dreams include becoming a teacher, but for right now she is going to be focused on going to and graduating from high school.

name: Amira
content: Amira is an enrolled member of the Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe. Amira has loved all the people she’s met here at St. Joseph’s. Her favorite class was Social Studies and the best thing about her home was the food. Amira is extremely grateful for the St. Joseph’s staff she was closest to, because they were helpful and kind. She is very proud of the grades she earned this year. Amira will always remember the girls that she hung out with the most. Her future hopes and dreams are to graduate high school, go to college and study to become a nurse!

name: Dayzah
content: Dayzah is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. She has participated in volleyball during her year here at St. Joseph’s. She has loved everything about St. Joseph’s this year! Dayzah’s favorite class was Religion and the best thing about her home was her houseparents and Rich and Tara’s food! She is most grateful for all of her grandmas, her mom and her dad. Dayzah is proud to be graduating the eighth grade. She will always remember her first time going to Jennie’s office because she was nervous, but Jennie was nice once she got to meet her! Dayzah’s future hopes and dreams include going into the Army and becoming a therapist one day.

name: Mariah
content: Mariah is a member of the Crow Creek Sioux Tribe. She has been involved in volleyball, basketball, cheer and the YES Girls program during her time at St. Joseph’s. She has loved how safe St. Joseph’s is and that she always had something to do! Mariah’s favorite class is math because there’s always a challenge to it. The best thing about her home was the girls, because they were family. Mariah is most grateful for her family because they accept the choices she makes. She is most proud of being Miss St. Joseph’s for her eighth grade year. Mariah will always remember the Seventh Grade Cultural trip because it was a fun experience! Mariah’s future hopes and dreams are to travel the world and be a photographer

name: JayCee
content: JayCee is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. She has been at St. Joseph’s since the third grade and has participated in basketball, volleyball and softball. She has loved the Seventh Grade Cultural trip as well as other trips while here at St. Joseph’s. JayCee’s favorite class is Personal Living Skills and the best things about her home were the houseparents. She is most grateful for the trips she went on with her home and school. Jaycee is proud of being able to express her culture and be herself at school. She will always remember the teachers and staff who helped her through her struggles, because if it weren’t for them, she says she would not be here today. JayCee’s future hopes and dreams are to graduate high school and college and to one day become a photographer.

name: Delmar
content: Delmar is enrolled in the Lower Brule Sioux Tribe. Delmar has been here at St. Joseph’s for six years, and has participated in basketball, football, softball, cross country, bowling and track. Delmar has loved all the activities St. Joseph’s has to offer. His favorite class is math because he finds it easy and the best things about his home were the people he got to be around, like his friends and houseparents. Delmar is most grateful for the great education and good food at St. Joseph’s. He is most proud of getting good grades. Delmar will always remember the Cultural Trip, the Explorer’s Club trips, and his teachers. His future hopes and dreams are to join the military and become a soldier.

name: Collin
content: Collin is a member of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe. He has been at St. Joseph’s since the third grade, during which time he was involved in basketball, football and softball. He has loved learning new stuff and going on trips while at St. Joseph’s. Collin’s favorite classes are Religion and PE, and the best things about his home are the houseparents and food. He is most grateful for the houseparents that have helped him through the years and for his grandma for enrolling him at St. Joseph’s. Collin is most proud of being able to do things on his own, and his improvements in sports. He will always remember the Seventh Grade Cultural trip, blocking Colton in the eighth grade vs. staff basketball game, and all the help given by his houseparents. Collin’s future hopes and dreams are to do well in high school, and be an electrician someday.
